svg.title: Recorded positions of an anonymous player
svg.desc: Metrica sample 1 · Player8 · 11.26 km from recorded coordinates · 145,006 finite-coordinate samples Stadium frame · nominal 105 × 68 m No change of attacking direction between halves applied Source: Metrica Sports sample data. Anonymous home player selected by distance from recorded coordinates. Sampled gaps >1s remain open. Occupancy describes recorded positions, not tactical role. Supplier detection flags are unavailable. Off-pitch coordinates enter boundary bins. No Gaussian smoothing; nearest-cell display, without interpolated intensity.
